verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਪੂਜੈ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਧੰਨਾ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: baamhan poojai dhevate dha(n)naa guoo charaavan aavai|

en.bdb: A brahman would worship gods (in the form of stone idols) where Dhanna used to graze his cow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਏਹੁ ਪੁਛੈ ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)nai ddiThaa chalit eh puchhai baamhan aakh sunaavai|

en.bdb: On seeing his worship, Dhanna asked the brahman what he was doing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: Thaakur dhee sevaa karai jo ichhai soiee fal paavai|

en.bdb: “Service to the Thakur (God) gives the desired fruit,” replied the brahman.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੈ ਭਿ ਦੇਹ ਇਕ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)naa karadhaa jodhaRee mai bh dheh ik je tudh bhaavai|

en.bdb: Dhanna requested, “O brahman, if you agree kindly give one to me.”

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਲਪੇਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇ ਧੰਨੈ ਨੋ ਗੈਲ ਛੁਡਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: pathar ik lapeT kar dhe dha(n)nai no gail chhuddaavai|

en.bdb: The brahman rolled a stone, gave it to Dhanna and thus got rid of him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੋ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਛਾਹਿ ਰੋਟੀ ਲੈ ਭੋਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: Thaakur no nhaavaal kai chhaeh roTee lai bhog chaRhaavai|

en.bdb: Dhanna bathed the Thakur and offered him bread and buttermilk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਮਿਨਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hath joR minat karai pairee pai pai bahut manaavai|

en.bdb: With folded hands and falling at the feet of the stone he begged for his service to be accepted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਨ ਜੁਠਾਲਸਾਂ ਤੂ ਰੁਠਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau bhee muh na juThaalasaa(n) too ruThaa mai kih na sukhaavai|

en.bdb: Dhanna said, “I will also not eat because how can I be happy if you are annoyed.”

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਹਿ ਛਾਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gosaiee paratakh hoi roTee khaeh chhaeh muh laavai|

en.bdb: (Seeing his true and loving devotion) God was forced to appear and eat his bread and buttermilk.
In fact, innocence like that of Dhanna makes the sight of the Lord available.
